title: archie.json
description: Architecture rules for Archie: layers, what each layer may depend on, and outside namespaces a layer must not use. Comments and trailing commas are allowed.

layerName.description: A layer name: letters, digits and '_', starting with a letter. No dots, so it can never be mistaken for a namespace.

namespacePattern.description: A namespace, matched segment by segment. It covers everything under it: 'MyApp.Domain' is MyApp.Domain and MyApp.Domain.Orders. '*' is one segment, '**' any number: 'MyApp.*.Domain'.

mustNotDependOn.description: Outside namespaces (not layers) this layer must not use, e.g. Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore. Reported as ARCH002. Merged with the top-level mustNotDependOn.

rootNamespace.description: The namespace the layer names in a list are relative to: with "MyApp", layer "Domain" is MyApp.Domain and everything under it.

layers.description: The layers. A list, top to bottom: each layer may depend on the layers below it. Or an object of named layers, each stating what it may depend on.

namespaces.description: The namespaces in this layer, when they are not rootNamespace.name.

mayDependOn.description: The layers this layer may depend on. Missing means nothing. A layer may always depend on itself.

mustNotDependOn.description: Per layer, outside namespaces it must not use, e.g. { "Domain": ["Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore"] }. Reported as ARCH002.

exclude.description: Namespaces whose code is not checked (legacy code). They still count when other code depends on them.

checkTestProjects.description: Test projects (IsTestProject=true) are not checked unless this is true.
